root_causes: payment_provider_url was changed to internal://payments-v2 (unlogged in recent_changes, only in config logs), so orders were processed without payments being recorded.
evidence: config log: payment_provider_url changed old internal://payments-v1 -> new internal://payments-v2
payment_gap: 13 of 27 orders processed with no payment
args.impact: Initially 13 of 27 orders were processed without payment (money_impact total_sar 6622.39). Reprocess paid 53 orders, money_recovered total_sar 26841.72, 0 failed. The reprocess count exceeded the 13 alerted, so unpaid orders had grown by then.
recommended_actions: Find who changed the provider URL and why, because the change was not recorded in recent_changes.
args.summary: An unrecorded config change pointed the payment provider at payments-v2, and orders were processed without payment. I reverted it to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. Invariants are now green.
